description: This file defines a React context and provider for managing the selection of input parameters within the Asset Details page of a data asset management system. It includes context creation, provider component, and a custom hook for consuming the context.

methods.name: InputParameterSelectionProvider
methods.description: Provides a React context for managing selected input parameter ID, encapsulating state and context value for children components.

methods.name: useInputParameterSelection
methods.description: Custom hook that allows components to access and manipulate the input parameter selection context.
